what: How many weighing and measuring devices did Lunenburg's Sealer test, seal or condemn in 2007, and what did inspection save consumers and merchants?
why: `report-weights-measures` holds the Sealer's device counts and the Chapter 295 savings-impact report from the 2010 annual town report. The 2007 report's Inspector of Weights & Measures narrative (PDF page 28) says `A summary sheet of devices inspected and savings to consumers and merchants impacted by this department is included in this report`, but no such table is printed: Textract found no table and no text on PDF page 30 (the scan holds 67 dark pixels of 3.7 million, a blank page), and the whole text was searched for sealed, devices, savings impact and Chapter 295 -- only the narrative (p28), the SEALING FEES receipt (p57) and the omnibus Sealer line (p90) came back. — closes: the Inspector of Weights & Measures' 2007 annual report to the Division of Standards (devices sealed, by type).

what: What were the town's non-union grade-and-step pay rates and job classifications for fiscal 2008?
why: `salary-schedule` and `report-classification-plan` read the Schedule A salary schedule and classification plan the 2010 report prints with its town meeting articles. The 2007 report's town meeting excerpts (PDF pages 87-109) mention the `Salary Administration Plan` only by name (p89, a 3% merit increase of $13,700.00) and print no schedule: the text was searched for salary schedule, classification plan, point value and grade, and returned nothing of the kind. — closes: the Town's Salary Administration Plan, Schedule A, as in force for FY2008.

what: How much of Lunenburg's debt at 30 June 2007 sat inside the debt limit, and how much outside it?
why: `outstanding-debt` reads this from the five-year outstanding-debt summary the FY2011-FY2025 reports print. The 2007 report prints bonded indebtedness issue by issue (PDF pages 76-78), and one schedule row is headed `MUNICIPAL PURPOSE PRINCIPAL (82% EXEMPT)` (p77), but there is no summary by purpose and no debt-limit split: the text was searched for debt limit, outside the debt, long-term indebtedness and outstanding debt and returned nothing. — closes: the Town's FY2007 Statement of Indebtedness as filed with the Division of Local Services.

what: What was the market value of each trust fund, the Stabilization Fund among them, at 30 June 2007?
why: `report-trust-funds` carries an ENDING MARKET VALUE column in the 2010 report (and the FY-era trust tables). The 2007 trust fund pages (PDF pages 74-75) print only `FY 07 ENDING CASH VALUE`, with a `REALIZED G/L FY 07` column and no unrealized gain or market value: the text was searched for market value and unrealized, and the only hits are bank money-market accounts on the treasurer's cash page (p73). — closes: the Treasurer's or custodian's 30 June 2007 trust fund statements at market value.

what: Do the 2007 annual report's gross wages cover calendar 2007 or fiscal 2007?
why: `report-gross-wages` is calendar earnings in the 2010 report and fiscal-year earnings from FY2011. The 2007 `PAYROLL REPORT` (PDF pages 110-121) prints EMPLOYEE, DEPARTMENT and GROSS WAGES and no year on any page, and the index (p3) calls it only `Payroll Report`; the text was searched for payroll, calendar and wages. Its rows cannot be put in a series with either kind until this is known. — closes: the Town Accountant's 2007 payroll register, or the W-2 totals for calendar 2007, against which a few named employees' figures could be matched.

what: As of what date are the 2007 annual report's tax collection balances stated?
why: `tax-collection` rows from the FY-era reports name their fiscal year. The 2007 `COLLECTION OF TAXES` page (PDF page 79) prints levy years from 1990 MVE to 2007 MVE and no fiscal year or as-of date anywhere on the page; the text was searched for 6/30/07, June 30, 2007 and fiscal year 2007, which appear on the balance sheet, special revenue, treasurer's, trust and debt pages but not this one. — closes: the Collector's FY2007 year-end report of committed taxes outstanding.
